commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
For the worthy, all the wealth they earn by effort is for doing their duty to others. It isn’t for eating alone, or for hoarding and losing, as with those who help no one.

தக்கார்க்கு can mean “for helping the worthy”, as the plain reading takes it. He takes the worthy as the ones who earn and help.
